abet.en: By staying silent, the bystander seemed to abet the bully in the hallway.
abet.zh: 旁觀者保持沉默，彷彿在走廊裡教唆那個霸凌者。

wreckingball.en: The crew swung the wreckingball into the abandoned warehouse at dawn.
wreckingball.zh: 施工隊在黎明時把拆遷球甩向那棟廢棄的倉庫。

dodge.en: She had to dodge a speeding scooter as she crossed the rainy street.
dodge.zh: 她過馬路時必須閃避一輛在雨中疾駛的機車。

slippery.en: The slippery salesman twisted every promise until the contract looked harmless.
slippery.zh: 那個狡猾的業務把每句承諾都扭曲到合約看似無害。

appraisal.en: The bank required a full appraisal before approving the mortgage on the house.
appraisal.zh: 銀行在核准房貸前，要求對這棟房子做完整的評估估價。

appraiser.en: An independent appraiser walked through the loft and noted every cracked beam.
appraiser.zh: 一位獨立估價師走遍整間閣樓，記下每根裂開的樑柱。

apprised.en: Once apprised of the delay, the coach rearranged the practice schedule.
apprised.zh: 教練一獲悉延誤的消息，就立刻重新安排了練習時間表。

valuation.en: Investors disputed the startup's valuation after its latest product flopped.
valuation.zh: 這家新創最近產品慘敗後，投資人開始質疑它的估值。

notify.en: Please notify the front desk if you lose your room key overnight.
notify.zh: 若你過夜時弄丟房卡，請通知櫃檯。

assessment.en: The midterm assessment covered every chapter taught since September.
assessment.zh: 期中評量涵蓋自九月以來教過的每一章。

briefing.en: The mayor held a short briefing about the bridge repair timeline.
briefing.zh: 市長就橋樑整修時程舉行了簡短的簡報。

counter.en: Shoppers lined up at the pharmacy counter for their flu shots.
counter.zh: 顧客在藥局櫃檯前排隊等候打流感疫苗。

queue.en: Students formed a long queue outside the cafeteria before lunch opened.
queue.zh: 午餐開賣前，學生在餐廳外排成一條長隊。

asperity.en: His asperity during the meeting made the younger staff afraid to speak.
asperity.zh: 他在會議中的粗魯語氣，讓年輕同事不敢開口。

aspersion.en: She cast an unfair aspersion on his honesty without offering any proof.
aspersion.zh: 她在毫無證據的情況下，對他的誠信加以誹謗中傷。

harsh.en: The desert wind felt harsh against their faces as they climbed the dune.
harsh.zh: 他們爬上沙丘時，沙漠的風打在臉上顯得又粗又烈。

slander.en: The newspaper paid damages after printing a clear slander about the athlete.
slander.zh: 報紙刊登對該選手的明顯誹謗後，付出了賠償金。

rumor.en: A wild rumor about school closure spread through the group chat by noon.
rumor.zh: 中午前，一則學校停課的離譜謠言已在群組傳開。

tone.en: The teacher's calm tone helped the nervous class settle before the quiz.
tone.zh: 老師平穩的語氣，讓緊張的班級在小考前安定下來。

ear.en: Cold air stung her ear as she waited for the late night bus.
ear.zh: 她在深夜等公車時，冷風刺痛了她的耳朵。

critique.en: After the recital, the instructor offered a careful critique of each solo.
critique.zh: 音樂會結束後，指導老師對每段獨奏提出仔細的批評。

gossip.en: Office gossip about the merger drowned out the real project updates.
gossip.zh: 辦公室關於併購的八卦，蓋過了真正的專案進度。

sharp.en: The chef kept a sharp knife ready beside the cutting board.
sharp.zh: 廚師在砧板上備好一把鋒利尖銳的刀。

wet.en: Her shoes were still wet after she walked home through the puddles.
wet.zh: 她踩著水窪走回家後，鞋子仍是濕的。

badge.en: Every volunteer wore a bright badge so visitors could ask for help.
badge.zh: 每位志工都戴著顯眼的徽章，方便遊客求助。

auspicious.en: Clear skies on opening day felt auspicious for the outdoor festival.
auspicious.zh: 開幕當天晴空萬里，對戶外慶典來說顯得吉祥有利。

propitious.en: A propitious breeze filled the sails just as the race began.
propitious.zh: 比賽一開始，一陣吉祥的風正好鼓起船帆。

ominous.en: Dark clouds and distant thunder created an ominous mood over the valley.
ominous.zh: 烏雲與遠方雷聲，讓山谷籠罩在凶兆的氣氛中。

favorable.en: Reviewers gave the new library a favorable report on lighting and space.
favorable.zh: 評論者對新圖書館的照明與空間給予有利的評價。

inauspicious.en: Losing the first match was an inauspicious start to the tournament.
inauspicious.zh: 輸掉第一場比賽，對這次錦標賽來說是不吉利的開局。

sunshine.en: Morning sunshine poured through the classroom windows after the storm.
sunshine.zh: 暴風雨過後，早晨的陽光從教室窗戶灑進來。

mic.en: The host tapped the mic twice before welcoming the audience on stage.
mic.zh: 主持人輕拍兩下麥克風，才上台向觀眾致意。

lucky.en: They felt lucky to catch the last train before the station closed.
lucky.zh: 他們趕上車站關閉前的末班車，覺得自己很幸運。

desk.en: Guests checked in at the hotel desk and received maps of the city.
desk.zh: 旅客在飯店櫃台辦理入住，並拿到市區地圖。

harmful.en: Too much screen time can be harmful to a child's sleep schedule.
harmful.zh: 螢幕時間過長，可能對孩子的睡眠作息有害。

unfavorable.en: Unfavorable weather forced the soccer final to move indoors.
unfavorable.zh: 不利的天氣迫使足球決賽改到室內舉行。

allergy.en: Her peanut allergy meant the cafeteria posted warnings on every tray.
allergy.zh: 她對花生過敏，因此餐廳在每個餐盤上都貼了警示。

setback.en: A sudden injury was a setback, yet the runner returned for spring races.
setback.zh: 突如其來的傷勢是一次挫敗，但跑者仍回來參加春季賽。

banal.en: The movie's banal dialogue made even the chase scenes feel tired.
banal.zh: 這部電影陳腐的對白，連追逐場面都顯得疲乏。

bane.en: Traffic jams remain the bane of every morning commute into the city.
bane.zh: 塞車仍是每天早上進城通勤的禍根。

bale.en: Years of war brought bale to families who once farmed the quiet plain.
bale.zh: 連年戰火把痛苦與不幸帶給曾在平靜平原耕作的家庭。

curse.en: In the folk tale, a jealous neighbor places a curse on the harvest.
curse.zh: 在民間故事裡，嫉妒的鄰居對收成下了詛咒。

disaster.en: The flood became a national disaster within hours of the dam break.
disaster.zh: 水壩潰決後數小時內，洪水就變成全國性的災難。

yawn.en: A loud yawn escaped him during the long afternoon lecture.
yawn.zh: 冗長的下午講課中，他忍不住打了一個大哈欠。

root.en: The gardener loosened the soil around the rose's thick root.
root.zh: 園丁把玫瑰粗根周圍的土壤鬆開。

prop.en: Timber beams prop the old roof so it will not collapse in snow.
prop.zh: 木樑支撐著舊屋頂，免得它被積雪壓垮。

shelf.en: She stacked the library books neatly on the middle shelf.
shelf.zh: 她把圖書館的書整齊堆在中層架子上。

boring.en: The two-hour presentation felt boring without a single concrete example.
boring.zh: 兩個小時的簡報沒有任何具體例子，顯得十分無聊。

doom.en: Many feared the volcanic ash cloud would doom the coastal fishing season.
doom.zh: 許多人擔心火山灰雲會註定沿海漁季的倒霉結局。

beget.en: Careless spending can beget debt that follows a family for years.
beget.zh: 揮霍無度可能引發長年纏身的債務。

beset.en: The expedition was beset by storms and dwindling food supplies.
beset.zh: 探險隊被暴風雨與日益減少的糧食所困擾。

cause.en: Investigators still debate the exact cause of the warehouse fire.
cause.zh: 調查人員仍在爭論倉庫大火的真正原因。

arrow.en: A painted arrow on the floor guided visitors toward the exit.
arrow.zh: 地板上畫的箭頭引導遊客走向出口。

problem.en: Finding enough parking near campus remains a daily problem for students.
problem.zh: 在校園附近找到足夠車位，仍是學生每天的問題。

blockade.en: Ships could not enter the harbor during the wartime naval blockade.
blockade.zh: 戰時海軍封鎖期間，船隻無法進入港口。

net.en: Fishermen hauled in a heavy net filled with silver mackerel.
net.zh: 漁民拉起裝滿銀色鯖魚的沉重漁網。

chain.en: The bicycle chain slipped off just as she reached the steep hill.
chain.zh: 她騎到陡坡時，腳踏車的鏈條正好脫落。

brandish.en: The knight would brandish his sword to scare the bandits away.
brandish.zh: 騎士會揮舞寶劍，嚇退那些強盜。

blandish.en: He tried to blandish the landlord with compliments before asking for a discount.
blandish.zh: 他先用甜言蜜語奉承房東，才開口要求打折。

bristle.en: Teachers bristle when parents accuse them without hearing both sides.
bristle.zh: 家長未聽雙方說法就指責時，老師會生氣發怒。

brittle.en: The brittle ice cracked under the first skater's weight.
brittle.zh: 易碎的薄冰在第一位溜冰者踩上去時就裂開了。

flourish.en: With a theatrical flourish, the magician waved the silk scarf overhead.
flourish.zh: 魔術師帶著炫耀的揮舞，把絲巾舉過頭頂。

anger.en: His anger cooled only after he apologized for the harsh words.
anger.zh: 他為刺耳的話道歉後，憤怒才慢慢平息。

sword.en: The museum displayed a rusted sword from the civil war era.
sword.zh: 博物館展出一把內戰時期生鏽的劍。

candy.en: Children traded colorful candy after the Halloween parade ended.
candy.zh: 萬聖節遊行結束後，孩子們交換五顏六色的糖果。

quill.en: The porcupine raised every quill when the dog came too close.
quill.zh: 狗靠得太近時，豪豬豎起每一根刺。

compliment.en: A sincere compliment about her essay made the shy student smile.
compliment.zh: 一句對她作文的真誠恭維，讓害羞的學生笑了。

threat.en: Rising sea levels pose a serious threat to the coastal village.
threat.zh: 海平面上升對沿海村莊構成嚴重威脅。

fur.en: The fox's thick fur kept it warm through the mountain winter.
fur.zh: 狐狸濃密的毛皮讓它安然度過山中寒冬。

smile.en: Her warm smile greeted every customer who entered the bakery.
smile.zh: 每位走進麵包店的顧客，都迎上她溫暖的笑容。

bumble.en: New volunteers often bumble through the first day of festival setup.
bumble.zh: 新志工常在節慶布置的第一天把事情搞砸。

bungle.en: They managed to bungle the simple handoff and lost the relay race.
bungle.zh: 他們把簡單的交接棒搞砸，因而輸掉接力賽。

stumble.en: He began to stumble over the rocky path after the flashlight died.
stumble.zh: 手電筒沒電後，他在崎嶇小徑上蹣跚掙扎前進。

fumble.en: In the dark hallway she had to fumble for the light switch.
fumble.zh: 在黑暗走廊裡，她只能笨手笨腳地摸索電燈開關。

botch.en: A rushed paint job can botch an otherwise careful renovation.
botch.zh: 倉促的油漆可能把原本細心的整修拙劣完成。

flub.en: The actor did not flub a single line during the live broadcast.
flub.zh: 在直播中，那位演員一句台詞都沒搞砸。

trip.en: A loose shoelace made him trip on the stairs before assembly.
trip.zh: 鬆掉的鞋帶讓他在集會前絆到樓梯。

floor.en: Janitors mopped the gym floor after the evening basketball game.
floor.zh: 晚間籃球賽結束後，清潔人員拖乾體育館地板。

wetfloor.en: A yellow sign marked the wetfloor near the lobby fountain.
wetfloor.zh: 大廳噴泉旁的濕地用黃色告示牌標示出來。

hands.en: Cold water made his hands stiff while he washed the camping dishes.
hands.zh: 他洗露營餐具時，冷水讓雙手變得僵硬。

feet.en: After the hike, her feet ached from miles of uneven trail.
feet.zh: 健行結束後，她的腳因走了數哩崎嶇步道而痠痛。

mess.en: The kitchen was a complete mess after the birthday cake disaster.
mess.zh: 生日蛋糕慘案之後，廚房變成一團糟。

corridor.en: Footsteps echoed down the empty school corridor after the final bell.
corridor.zh: 放學鐘響後，腳步聲在空蕩的學校走廊迴盪。

cone.en: Workers placed an orange traffic cone beside the open manhole.
cone.zh: 工人在打開的人孔旁放了一個橘色交通圓錐筒。

bustle.en: Shoppers bustle through the night market before the stalls close.
bustle.zh: 攤位收攤前，購物者在夜市裡忙碌奔走。

hustle.en: Couriers hustle packages across downtown during the holiday rush.
hustle.zh: 耶誕旺季時，快遞人員在市區催趕奔忙送貨。

hurtle.en: Debris began to hurtle down the slope after the landslide started.
hurtle.zh: 山崩開始後，碎石沿著斜坡猛烈撞擊滾落。

hurdle.en: Clearing the final hurdle, she won the school track championship.
hurdle.zh: 跨過最後一道跨欄障礙後，她贏得校內田徑冠軍。

rush.en: Commuters rush for the subway doors when the train arrives.
rush.zh: 列車進站時，通勤者衝向地鐵車門。

turntable.en: The DJ spun a vinyl record on the club's glowing turntable.
turntable.zh: DJ 在夜店發光的轉盤上轉動黑膠唱片。

speed.en: Cameras catch drivers who exceed the posted speed near schools.
speed.zh: 測速相機會拍下在學校附近超速行駛的駕駛。

market.en: Fresh herbs filled every stall at the weekend farmers market.
market.zh: 週末農夫市集的每個攤位都擺滿新鮮香草。

dash.en: She had to dash across campus to reach the exam on time.
dash.zh: 她必須飛奔穿越校園，才能準時趕到考試。

announce.en: The station will announce platform changes over the loudspeakers.
announce.zh: 車站會透過廣播宣布月台變更。

lane.en: Each sprinter stayed in the assigned lane through the final stretch.
lane.zh: 每位短跑選手在最後衝刺段都待在指定跑道上。

cart.en: A grocery cart rattled down the aisle under a tower of cereal boxes.
cart.zh: 一輛推車載著高高一疊麥片盒，嘎嘎穿過走道。

horn.en: A taxi horn blared as pedestrians stepped into the crosswalk.
horn.zh: 行人走進斑馬線時，計程車喇叭突然大響。

blame.en: It is unfair to blame the intern for a decision made by managers.
blame.zh: 把經理做的決定怪到實習生頭上並不公平。

blacklist.en: Airlines may blacklist passengers who refuse to follow safety rules.
blacklist.zh: 航空公司可能把拒絕遵守安全規定的旅客列入黑名單。

approve.en: The council must approve the budget before construction can begin.
approve.zh: 議會必須先批准預算，工程才能開工。

edit.en: The film student stayed late to edit the final classroom documentary.
edit.zh: 電影系學生熬夜剪輯課堂紀錄片的最終版本。

chaff.en: Friends like to chaff one another about old high-school nicknames.
chaff.zh: 朋友們喜歡拿高中舊綽號互相開玩笑。

chagrin.en: To his chagrin, the presentation slides froze in front of the class.
chagrin.zh: 令他懊惱不安的是，簡報投影片在全班面前當機了。

cherubic.en: The toddler's cherubic face made even stern judges soften their tone.
cherubic.zh: 幼兒那張嬰兒般的臉，連嚴厲的評審都語氣變軟。

chary.en: Investors grew chary of startups that never published clear accounts.
chary.zh: 投資人對從不公開清楚帳目的新創變得謹慎。

tease.en: Older siblings often tease younger ones about forgotten homework.
tease.zh: 兄姊常取笑弟弟妹妹忘了帶作業。

angel.en: In the mural, a painted angel watches over the sleeping village.
angel.zh: 壁畫裡，一位天使俯視著沉睡的村莊。

locker.en: Athletes stuffed sweaty gear into the locker after practice ended.
locker.zh: 練習結束後，選手把汗濕裝備塞進更衣室置物櫃。

joke.en: His clumsy joke about traffic lights finally made the tired class laugh.
joke.zh: 他關於紅綠燈的笨拙玩笑，終於讓疲憊的班級笑了。

frown.en: Parents frown upon students who skip class without a real reason.
frown.zh: 家長對無故翹課的學生表示厭惡與皺眉。

coach.en: The basketball coach ran drills until every player hit free throws.
coach.zh: 籃球教練反覆操練，直到每位球員都能投進罰球。

blush.en: She began to blush when the teacher praised her poem aloud.
blush.zh: 老師當眾稱讚她的詩時，她的臉紅了起來。

wink.en: Grandpa gave a playful wink before revealing the birthday surprise.
wink.zh: 爺爺在揭曉生日驚喜前，俏皮地眨了一下眼。

sigh.en: A long sigh escaped her after she finished the last exam question.
sigh.zh: 答完最後一題考題後，她長長地嘆了一口氣。

halo.en: Streetlights cast a soft halo around the foggy park entrance.
halo.zh: 路燈在霧氣瀰漫的公園入口投下柔和光環。

complaisant.en: The complaisant host agreed to every guest request without complaint.
complaisant.zh: 那位順從的主人毫無怨言地答應每位客人的要求。

complaisance.en: Her endless complaisance left little time for her own projects.
complaisance.zh: 她無止盡的順從殷勤，幾乎沒有時間做自己的計畫。

smug.en: The smug winner smirked as if the contest had never been close.
smug.zh: 那個自命不凡的贏家壞笑著，彷彿比賽從未膠著過。

ingratiating.en: His ingratiating smile appeared whenever the principal entered the room.
ingratiating.zh: 校長一進教室，他就換上討人喜歡的奉迎笑容。

fawning.en: Fawning assistants surrounded the celebrity after every press event.
fawning.zh: 每次記者會後，奉承討好的助理都圍在名人身邊。

smugness.en: His smugness after one good quiz annoyed classmates who still struggled.
smugness.zh: 他一次小考考好就沾沾自喜，惹惱了仍在苦讀的同學。

smirk.en: A knowing smirk crossed her face when the rumor proved false.
smirk.zh: 謠言被證明是假的時，她臉上掠過一抹假笑。

flatterer.en: A practiced flatterer praised every idea the boss mentioned at lunch.
flatterer.zh: 老練的諂媚者在午餐時對老闆提起的每個主意都大加讚美。

makeup.en: She applied light makeup before stepping onto the school stage.
makeup.zh: 踏上學校舞台前，她化了淡淡的妝。

contrite.en: A contrite student returned the stolen lunch money with a written apology.
contrite.zh: 那位後悔的學生歸還偷走的午餐錢，並附上書面道歉。

trite.en: His speech relied on trite slogans that no one found inspiring.
trite.zh: 他的演說盡是平庸陳腐的口號，無人覺得鼓舞。

repentant.en: The repentant driver volunteered at the clinic after causing the crash.
repentant.zh: 那位懺悔的駕駛在肇事後到診所擔任志工。

cliche.en: Calling every challenge a journey has become a tired advertising cliche.
cliche.zh: 把每個挑戰都叫作旅程，已成廣告裡用濫的陳腔。

slogan.en: Campaign volunteers painted the new slogan across homemade banners.
slogan.zh: 競選志工把新口號漆在自製的橫幅上。

tear.en: A single tear rolled down her cheek when the choir began to sing.
tear.zh: 合唱團一開唱，一滴淚就滑過她的臉頰。

sticker.en: Kids covered their water bottles with a bright space-themed sticker.
sticker.zh: 孩子們用鮮豔的太空主題貼紙貼滿水壺。

vending.en: Coins jammed the vending machine beside the science classroom.
vending.zh: 科學教室旁的販賣機被硬幣卡住了。

guilt.en: Guilt kept him awake after he forgot his friend's birthday dinner.
guilt.zh: 忘記朋友的生日晚餐後，愧疚讓他徹夜難眠。

boredom.en: Rainy weekends often bring boredom to kids stuck indoors.
boredom.zh: 下雨的週末常讓困在室內的孩子感到無聊。

overused.en: That joke is so overused that even the teacher rolls her eyes.
overused.zh: 那個玩笑已經用濫到連老師都翻白眼。

coin.en: Writers sometimes coin a new phrase that later enters everyday speech.
coin.zh: 作家有時會創造新詞或短語，後來進入日常用語。

delude.en: False headlines can delude readers into believing an easy miracle cure.
delude.zh: 不實標題可能欺騙讀者，讓他們相信簡單的神奇療法。

deluge.en: A sudden deluge flooded the subway stairs within minutes.
deluge.zh: 突如其來的大洪水在幾分鐘內淹沒地鐵階梯。

divulge.en: Reporters refused to divulge the identity of their confidential source.
divulge.zh: 記者拒絕泄露機密消息來源的身分。

flood.en: Sandbags lined the riverbank as the spring flood rose overnight.
flood.zh: 春汛連夜上漲時，河岸堆起一排沙袋。

secret.en: They kept the surprise party a secret until she walked through the door.
secret.zh: 他們把驚喜派對當成祕密，直到她推門進來。

leak.en: A roof leak stained the classroom ceiling after days of heavy rain.
leak.zh: 連日大雨後，屋頂洩漏把教室天花板染上水漬。

nozzle.en: The firefighter adjusted the hose nozzle before aiming at the flames.
nozzle.zh: 消防隊員調整水帶噴嘴後，才對準火燄射水。

studio.en: Art students shared a crowded studio filled with half-finished canvases.
studio.zh: 美術系學生共用一間堆滿半成品畫布的擁擠工作室。

truth.en: Witnesses finally told the truth about what happened on the bridge.
truth.zh: 目擊者終於說出橋上事件的真相。

alarm.en: The fire alarm pulled everyone out of the dorm into the courtyard.
alarm.zh: 火警警報把所有人從宿舍趕到中庭。

separate.en: Teachers keep quiz papers in a separate folder from homework stacks.
separate.zh: 老師把小考卷與作業分開放在不同資料夾。

careful.en: Be careful crossing the icy bridge after last night's freeze.
careful.zh: 昨晚結冰後，過那座橋時要特別小心。

compartmentalize.en: She learned to compartmentalize work stress so evenings stayed peaceful.
compartmentalize.zh: 她學會劃分工壓，好讓晚上仍能平靜度過。

partition.en: A glass partition divides the quiet reading area from the noisy cafe.
partition.zh: 一道玻璃隔間把安靜閱讀區與嘈雜咖啡廳分割開來。

epochal.en: Landing on the moon was an epochal moment for science and television.
epochal.zh: 登陸月球對科學與電視傳播都是劃時代的時刻。

annal.en: Each royal annal recorded droughts, wars, and harvests year by year.
annal.zh: 每一部王室編年紀錄都逐年記載乾旱、戰爭與收成。

annals.en: Her discovery entered the annals of medicine within a single decade.
annals.zh: 她的發現在十年內就寫進醫學編年史。

historiography.en: Modern historiography questions whose voices older textbooks left out.
historiography.zh: 現代史學寫作質疑舊教科書遺漏了誰的聲音。

bygone.en: Grandparents still tell stories from bygone summers at the lake house.
bygone.zh: 祖父母仍講述過去在湖邊小屋度過的那些夏天。

yesteryear.en: Fashion magazines revived the bright colors of yesteryear for spring.
yesteryear.zh: 時尚雜誌把往昔鮮豔的色彩帶回春裝系列。

antiquarian.en: An antiquarian bookshop sold maps drawn before the city had subways.
antiquarian.zh: 一家古文物書店出售地鐵出現前繪製的城市地圖。

periodization.en: Historians debate the periodization of the Renaissance across regions.
periodization.zh: 史學家爭論文藝復興在各地區應如何分期。

blackboard.en: Chalk dust covered the blackboard after the algebra demonstration.
blackboard.zh: 代數示範結束後，黑板佈滿粉筆灰。

chalk.en: The teacher broke a stick of chalk while writing the homework list.
chalk.zh: 老師寫作業清單時折斷了一根粉筆。

museumcard.en: Students showed a museumcard at the gate for free weekend entry.
museumcard.zh: 學生在門口出示博物館卡，即可免費週末入場。

yearbook.en: Seniors signed one another's yearbook on the final day of school.
yearbook.zh: 畢業班在最後一天互相在年鑑上簽名。

scroll.en: The museum unrolled an ancient scroll under soft protective lights.
scroll.zh: 博物館在柔和的防護燈光下展開一卷古代卷軸。

plaque.en: A bronze plaque on the wall names the donors who funded the wing.
plaque.zh: 牆上的銅製牌匾刻著贊助這棟側廂的捐款人姓名。

dustybook.en: She pulled a dustybook from the attic and found pressed flowers inside.
dustybook.zh: 她從閣樓抽出一本塵書，發現裡夾著壓乾的花。

incredulity.en: Incredulity filled the room when the magician claimed to read minds.
incredulity.zh: 魔術師聲稱能讀心時，滿室都是不輕信的表情。

credulity.en: Advertisers exploit the credulity of shoppers chasing miracle diets.
credulity.zh: 廣告商利用追求神奇減肥法的購物者那份輕信。

dubiety.en: Dubiety lingered after the mayor offered only vague answers.
dubiety.zh: 市長只給出含糊答覆後，懷疑的情緒仍揮之不去。

amazement.en: Tourists stared in amazement at the waterfall crashing into the gorge.
amazement.zh: 遊客驚異地盯著瀑布衝進峽谷的景象。

astonishment.en: Gasps of astonishment rose when the quiet student won first prize.
astonishment.zh: 那位安靜的學生贏得首獎時，現場發出驚訝的抽氣聲。

stupefaction.en: Stupefaction froze the crowd as the statue suddenly began to move.
stupefaction.zh: 雕像突然開始移動時，人群驚呆得動彈不得。

wonderment.en: Children watched the planetarium show in quiet wonderment.
wonderment.zh: 孩子們帶著安靜的驚奇觀看天文館的星象秀。

stage.en: Spotlights warmed the stage before the school orchestra entered.
stage.zh: 學校管弦樂團進場前，聚光燈先照暖了舞台。

audience.en: The audience clapped for an encore after the final violin solo.
audience.zh: 最後一段小提琴獨奏結束後，觀眾鼓掌要求安可。

gasp.en: A collective gasp filled the stadium when the ball hit the crossbar.
gasp.zh: 球撞上球門橫木時，整座球場發出倒抽氣的聲音。

eyebrow.en: One raised eyebrow from the librarian silenced the whispering table.
eyebrow.zh: 圖書館員挑起一邊眉毛，就讓竊竊私語的那桌安靜下來。

magic.en: Street magic drew a circle of tourists around the busy plaza.
magic.zh: 街頭魔術在熱鬧廣場上吸引了一圈遊客。

curtaincall.en: Actors returned for a curtaincall as roses landed on the boards.
curtaincall.zh: 玫瑰砸上舞台時，演員們回來謝幕。

doubtface.en: His doubtface appeared the moment the witness changed the story.
doubtface.zh: 證人一改口，他臉上就露出懷疑臉。

wow.en: Kids shouted wow when the science demo made the liquid change color.
wow.zh: 科學示範讓液體變色時，孩子們齊聲喊哇。

ingenuity.en: Classroom ingenuity turned cardboard boxes into a working model bridge.
ingenuity.zh: 課堂上的巧思把紙箱變成一座能承重的模型橋。

naive.en: A naive tourist left cash on the cafe table and walked away.
naive.zh: 一位天真的遊客把現金留在咖啡桌就走了。

resourceful.en: The resourceful camper built a shelter from fallen branches and tarps.
resourceful.zh: 足智多謀的露營者用斷枝與防水布搭起遮蔽處。

perspective.en: Traveling abroad gave her a broader perspective on everyday customs.
perspective.zh: 出國旅行讓她對日常習俗有了更寬廣的視角。

viewpoint.en: Each panelist offered a different viewpoint on reforming school lunch.
viewpoint.zh: 每位與談人對改革學校午餐都提出不同觀點。

standpoint.en: From a parent's standpoint, shorter homework nights feel healthier.
standpoint.zh: 從家長的立場觀點看，作業較少的夜晚更健康。

vantage.en: From a high vantage on the hill, they watched fireworks over the bay.
vantage.zh: 他們從山上有利位置俯瞰海灣上空的煙火。

foresight.en: City planners showed foresight by planting trees along the new avenue.
foresight.zh: 都市規劃者在新大道兩旁種樹，展現了先見。

hindsight.en: In hindsight, packing an umbrella would have saved the picnic.
hindsight.zh: 事後看來，帶把傘就能保住那場野餐。

imminent.en: Sirens warned that a severe thunderstorm was imminent over the city.
imminent.zh: 警報聲警告強雷雨即將發生在城市上空。

approaching.en: Birds scattered as the approaching storm darkened the shoreline.
approaching.zh: 接近中的暴風雨讓海岸變暗，鳥兒四散飛走。

upcoming.en: Posters advertised the upcoming concert on every campus bulletin board.
upcoming.zh: 每塊校園佈告欄都貼出海報宣傳即將到來的演唱會。

binoculars.en: Birdwatchers raised binoculars to follow the crane across the marsh.
binoculars.zh: 觀鳥者舉起雙筒望遠鏡，追蹤飛越沼澤的鶴。

deck.en: Passengers stood on the ship's upper deck to photograph the harbor.
deck.zh: 乘客站在船上的觀景甲板拍攝港灣景色。

lenscap.en: He almost missed the shot because the lenscap was still on the camera.
lenscap.zh: 他差點錯過那張照片，因為鏡頭蓋還蓋在相機上。

map.en: Hikers unfolded a waterproof map beside the mountain trail marker.
map.zh: 健行者在山徑標示旁攤開防水地圖。

compass2.en: The scout checked compass2 before choosing which ridge to climb.
compass2.zh: 童軍在決定爬哪條山脊前，先確認羅盤2的方位。

tomorrow.en: The coach reminded everyone that tomorrow's game starts at dawn.
tomorrow.zh: 教練提醒大家，明天的比賽天一亮就開始。

anglemark.en: Surveyors painted an anglemark on the sidewalk before laying new pipe.
anglemark.zh: 測量人員在人行道上畫好角度標記，才開始埋新管線。

respectfully.en: Students stood respectfully when the principal entered the auditorium.
respectfully.zh: 校長走進禮堂時，學生恭敬地起立。

respectively.en: Alice and Ben scored ninety and eighty-five respectively on the quiz.
respectively.zh: 愛麗絲與班在小考中分別得到九十分與八十五分。

respectful.en: A respectful silence fell as veterans walked onto the field.
respectful.zh: 退伍軍人走進球場時，現場響起恭敬的沉默。

respective.en: Players returned to their respective lockers after the final whistle.
respective.zh: 終場哨響後，球員各自回到自己的置物櫃。

disrespectful.en: Talking through a memorial service is widely seen as disrespectful.
disrespectful.zh: 在追思會中交談被普遍視為不敬。

irrespective.en: The rule applies to all students irrespective of club membership.
irrespective.zh: 這條規定適用於所有學生，不考慮是否加入社團。

respectability.en: The family prized respectability and kept scandals out of the papers.
respectability.zh: 那家人重視體面，不讓醜聞登上報紙。

esteem.en: Colleagues held her in high esteem for mentoring every new hire.
esteem.zh: 同事因她輔導每位新人而對她十分尊重。

bowtie.en: He adjusted his bowtie twice before stepping up to the podium.
bowtie.zh: 走上講台前，他調整了兩次領結。

nametag.en: Every conference guest wore a nametag printed with school and city.
nametag.zh: 每位與會來賓都戴著印有學校與城市的名牌。

queue2.en: Volunteers opened a second queue2 for guests with reserved tickets.
queue2.zh: 志工為持預約票的來賓另開一條排隊2動線。

handshake2.en: Diplomats practiced handshake2 before cameras entered the hall.
handshake2.zh: 攝影機進場前，外交官先演練握手2的動作。

seating.en: The usher checked the seating chart before guiding families to rows.
seating.zh: 帶位員先核對座位表，才引導家庭入座。

salute.en: Soldiers raised a sharp salute as the flag rose over the parade ground.
salute.zh: 國旗在閱兵場升起時，士兵行了標準敬禮。

title.en: Her official title on the door read Director of Student Affairs.
title.zh: 門上的正式頭銜寫著學生事務主任。

orderlist.en: Kitchen staff followed the orderlist taped beside the prep counter.
orderlist.zh: 廚房人員依照貼在備料台旁的順序列表作業。

sensual.en: The novel's sensual descriptions of summer nights drew mixed reviews.
sensual.zh: 小說對夏夜感官情慾的描寫，引來褒貶不一的評論。

sensuous.en: Listeners enjoyed the sensuous warmth of cello notes in the chapel.
sensuous.zh: 聽眾沉浸在教堂裡大提琴音符愉悅感官的溫暖中。

sensuousness.en: Critics praised the painting's sensuousness of color and soft light.
sensuousness.zh: 評論家稱讚這幅畫在色彩與柔光上的感官美。

carnal.en: Medieval sermons warned against carnal temptation at carnival feasts.
carnal.zh: 中世紀講道警告人們在嘉年華盛宴中提防肉慾誘惑。

voluptuous.en: The palace gardens offered a voluptuous display of flowers and fountains.
voluptuous.zh: 宮殿花園以花卉與噴泉展現奢侈逸樂的景象。

epicurean.en: An epicurean dinner paired rare cheeses with local mountain honey.
epicurean.zh: 一頓享樂美食晚餐把罕見起司與在地山蜜搭配上桌。

aesthete.en: As an aesthete, he arranged every vase for perfect visual balance.
aesthete.zh: 身為唯美主義者，他把每個花瓶都擺到視覺完美平衡。

palpable.en: Tension in the courtroom was palpable before the verdict was read.
palpable.zh: 宣判前，法庭裡的緊張氣氛感覺得到。

kitchen.en: Soup simmered on the stove while the kitchen filled with garlic scent.
kitchen.zh: 湯在爐上慢燉，廚房裡瀰漫著大蒜香氣。

gallery.en: Visitors whispered as they wandered through the quiet art gallery.
gallery.zh: 遊客壓低聲音，漫步在安靜的畫廊裡。

perfume.en: A light perfume of jasmine drifted from the open shop doorway.
perfume.zh: 一抹淡淡的茉莉香水味從敞開的店門飄出。

brush.en: She cleaned her paint brush carefully before switching to blue tones.
brush.zh: 她仔細清洗畫筆後，才換成藍色調繼續畫。

menu.en: The cafe printed a seasonal menu featuring roasted squash soup.
menu.zh: 咖啡店印出季節菜單，主打烤南瓜湯。

canvas.en: Wet oil paint still glistened on the large studio canvas.
canvas.zh: 工作室裡大幅畫布上的油畫顏料仍閃著濕潤光澤。

spice.en: Vendors sold cinnamon and other spice in small paper packets.
spice.zh: 攤販把肉桂和其他香料裝在小紙袋裡販售。

frame.en: They chose a dark wooden frame for the family portrait.
frame.zh: 他們為全家福選了一個深色木製畫框。

venality.en: Investigators exposed the venality that had infected the customs office.
venality.zh: 調查人員揭發已侵蝕海關辦公室的貪腐。

bribery.en: The contractor was charged with bribery after cash changed hands.
bribery.zh: 現金易手後，承包商因賄賂遭到起訴。

forgivable.en: Arriving five minutes late seemed forgivable after the subway stalled.
forgivable.zh: 地鐵故障後遲到五分鐘，顯得可以原諒。

excusable.en: Missing one rehearsal was excusable once her fever was confirmed.
excusable.zh: 確認發燒後，缺席一次排練變得可諒解。

kickback.en: The audit found a kickback hidden inside inflated equipment invoices.
kickback.zh: 審計在灌水的設備發票裡找出一筆回扣。

graft.en: Newspapers blasted the mayor over years of quiet political graft.
graft.zh: 報紙抨擊市長多年隱密的政治貪污。

pardonable.en: A single careless typo felt pardonable in such a long report.
pardonable.zh: 在這麼長的報告裡，一個疏忽的錯字顯得可赦免。

payola.en: Radio hosts lost jobs after the payola scandal broke nationwide.
payola.zh: 全國封口賄賂醜聞爆發後，電台主持人紛紛丟職。

corruptibility.en: Watchdogs tested the corruptibility of officials with fake bribe offers.
corruptibility.zh: 監督團體用假賄賂測試官員的可腐化程度。

courtroom.en: Cameras were banned from the courtroom during the sensitive trial.
courtroom.zh: 這場敏感審判期間，法庭內禁止攝影。

gavel.en: The judge struck the gavel to quiet the noisy spectators.
gavel.zh: 法官敲下小木槌，喝止嘈雜的旁聽群眾。

ticket.en: She paid the parking ticket before the late fee doubled the fine.
ticket.zh: 她在滯納金把罰款加倍前，先繳清停車罰單。
